title: 西藏故事走向海外屏幕
subtitle: 一部微短剧的六种语言旅程

article.en: A Chinese micro-drama set in Xizang is traveling well beyond China. The series, "Where Peach Blossoms Bloom", follows a botanist who goes back to Taohua, a village in Nyingchi, with a plan to grow rare lingzhi mushrooms. His plan falls apart when his childhood friend cooks the precious seed stock in chicken soup. A food blogger who has not spoken to her father for years and a young inheritor of traditional skills also appear, and the three stories meet at the village's peach blossom festival. The first part of the franchise was streamed on ten online platforms and fifteen provincial television channels, and it was broadcast in seven languages to viewers in more than ten countries and regions. Since the second part came out earlier this year, the drama has gathered over 600 million online clicks and over 500 million television views. Researchers say the drama offers something that computer-made pictures cannot. Professor Kan Ping of Xi'an Jiaotong University believes it escapes flat stereotypes and gives its characters real feeling, while Lyu Fan of Peking University praises the striking natural scenery of snow-covered mountains and peach blossom forests. Both hope such shows can bring more visitors to the region and spread its heritage.
article.zh: 一部以西藏为背景的中国微短剧正在走向中国之外。剧集《桃花盛开的地方》讲述了一位植物学家回到林芝桃花村，计划栽培珍贵灵芝的故事。他的计划被儿时玩伴搅乱——对方把宝贵的灵芝菌种炖进了鸡汤里。剧里还有一位多年没和父亲说话的食物博主，以及一位守护传统技艺的年轻非遗传承人，三条线索在桃花节上汇合。 第一部在十个网络平台和十五个省级电视台播出，并以七种语言在十多个国家和地区播映。自今年第二部上线以来，该剧网络点击量已超过六亿次，电视观看量超过五亿次。 研究人员认为，这部剧提供了电脑生成画面难以替代的东西。西安交通大学的康平教授认为它跳出了扁平的刻板印象，让人物有真实情感；北京大学的吕凡则称赞剧中雪覆盖的山脉和桃花林等出色的自然风光。两人都希望这类作品能为当地带来更多游客，把地区的文化传承扩散出去。

vocab.ex: A Chinese micro-drama set in Xizang is traveling overseas.
vocab.note: 短剧单集短、节奏快；海外平台常称 short drama

vocab.ex: The series follows a botanist who returns to his village.
vocab.note: 四六级阅读常见；动词形式 botanize 植物分类学

vocab.ex: He plans to grow rare lingzhi mushrooms.
vocab.note: 可数名词；灵芝是灵芝属真菌

vocab.ex: A young inheritor works to preserve traditional skills.
vocab.note: intangible cultural heritage inheritor 非遗传承人

vocab.ex: The first part of the franchise was streamed online.
vocab.note: 此处指「系列剧」；商业语境也指连锁品牌

vocab.ex: The first part was streamed on ten online platforms.
vocab.note: stream sb ＝在平台播出；名词 a stream of praise

vocab.ex: The drama has collected more than 600 million online clicks.
vocab.note: 点击量用复数 clicks；click on ＝点击（鼠标）

vocab.ex: The drama moves beyond stereotypical narratives.
vocab.note: break away from stereotypes 跳出刻板印象

vocab.ex: The series shows the striking natural scenery of Xizang.
vocab.note: 不可数名词；不要写成 sceneries

vocab.ex: Such shows can spread the region's heritage.
vocab.note: cultural heritage 文化遗产；heritage 不可数

vocab.ex: The show may draw more visitors to the region.
vocab.note: in the region / across the region；四级高频

vocab.ex: The story takes place in a small village.
vocab.note: village 村庄；urban 城市的（反义）

translation.title: 影视出海与文化传播：微短剧的多语种发行
translation.brief: 下面五句对应本篇「影视出海与文化传播」话题，按「动态—数据—数据—原因—展望」推进。数字改写和时态是本篇的重点采分点。

sentences.cn: 西藏微短剧《桃花盛开的地方》正走向海外，计划12月在多个国家以六种语言播出。
sentences.ref: The Xizang-themed micro-drama Where Peach Blossoms Bloom is going overseas and is planned to be released in six languages in several countries in December.

hints.struct: 主语 + is going + and is planned

pts.t: 正走向海外 用进行时 is going overseas；「正在」别漏掉 be + doing。
计划……播出 用 is planned to be released；「计划」在这里是安排，用被动式 is planned to 更准确。
以六种语言 用 in six languages；表示「用某种语言」介词用 in，不能用 by。
剧名是专有名词，用书名号对应的直译 Where Peach Blossoms Bloom，前面加破折号或逗号引出。

sentences.cn: 首季在10个网络平台和15个省级卫视播出，并以七种语言在十多个国家播映。
sentences.ref: Its first season was shown on ten online platforms and fifteen provincial satellite television channels, and was broadcast in seven languages in more than ten countries.

hints.struct: 被动 was shown on / was broadcast in

pts.t: 「首季在……播出」用被动 was shown on；on 表示「在哪个平台/频道上」。
网络平台 用 online platforms；省级卫视 用 provincial satellite television channels，两个并列结构都要译出。
以七种语言播映 用 was broadcast in seven languages；broadcast 是「播出」的正确词，play 在这里是错的。

sentences.cn: 自今年第二季上线以来，该剧点击量已超过六亿次，电视观看量超过五亿次。
sentences.ref: Since the second season was released earlier this year, the drama has collected more than 600 million online clicks and over 500 million television views.

hints.struct: Since + 从句 + 现在完成时 has collected

pts.t: 自……以来 用 Since the second season was released earlier this year；since 引导的从句用过去时被动。
上线 译 was released；上线是「被发布」，不能写成 released 直接跟宾语。
超过六亿次 用 more than 600 million；数字改写成英文时「亿」用 hundred million，「六亿」＝600 million。
主句用现在完成时 has collected，与「自……以来」呼应。

sentences.cn: 专家认为，该剧受欢迎是因为它突破了刻板印象，用真实情感打动观众。
sentences.ref: Experts believe that the drama is popular because it breaks away from stereotypes and wins viewers over with real emotions.

hints.struct: Experts believe that + because + 主句并列

pts.t: 专家认为 用 Experts believe that ...；that 从句不能省略（正式书面语）。
突破了刻板印象 用 breaks away from stereotypes；break away from 表示「摆脱、跳脱」。
打动观众 用 wins viewers over；win sb over ＝赢得某人的支持，是固定搭配。
两个并列原因用 and 连接，不要写成两个 because 从句。

sentences.cn: 如果更多微短剧能展示自然风光和地方文化，就可能带动当地旅游经济。
sentences.ref: If more micro-dramas can show natural scenery and local culture, they may also drive the local tourism economy.

hints.struct: If + 条件从句 + 主句 may do

pts.t: 如果……就可能 用 If ... , they may also ...；条件从句用现在时，主句用 may + 动词原形。
带动 用 drive；不要写 bring the tourism economy，drive 才表示「带动、拉动」。
当地旅游经济 用 the local tourism economy；local 修饰名词组比 in the local 位置更自然。

exprs.note: abroad/overseas 是副词；进行时表「正在」。
计划用被动 is planned to do。
用语言用 in，不用 by。

exprs.en: Since the second season was released

exprs.note: win sb over 固定搭配。

translation.classroomNote: 课堂速练用的两句（2 句模式默认出这两句；5 句全练出全部）
